name: dsh-codex-ui-classic
description: The Codex UI 1.1.49 sidebar, frozen inside one self-contained plugin, plus a real conversation delete. The 1.1.49 UI (Apache-2.0) is vendored so no upstream release can change it, unused navigation is trimmed, the package provides remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession so the session menu grows its 删除会话 row, it restores the row's ⋯ button, and it asks with a family tree before removing a conversation that carries subagent sessions or forked conversations. The Host delete engine is derived from better-dsh-session-deletetool (MIT). No dependency on the @michengai/dsh-codex-ui package at install time. / 把 Codex UI 1.1.49 的界面冻结进插件：侧栏代码内置、用不到的导航裁掉，上游更新不会再把界面换掉；同时补上真正的删除对话——提供 remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession 让会话菜单出现「删除会话」，修好被隐藏的「⋯」按钮，会话带着子智能体或派生对话时先弹家族树勾选。Host 删除引擎改编自 better-dsh-session-deletetool，安装时不再依赖 codex-ui 包。
author: memoryovo

meta.title: Codex UI 经典版（内置 1.1.49）/ Codex UI Classic (bundled 1.1.49)
meta.description: 把 Codex UI 1.1.49 那一版界面冻结在插件里，上游怎么更新都换不掉；顺带给你真正能用的删除会话。删除不是归档隐藏，而是删掉会话日志、工程记录与投影缓存；会话带着子智能体会话或派生对话时，先按层级列出来让你勾选，运行中的工作也会标出来。右键与三个小点两条路都能调出同一个菜单。因为界面代码就在插件里，不装 codex-ui 也能跑。
